# 🧰 Reusable Project Templates

These templates provide structured records for project changes. Replace each placeholder, distinguish facts from proposals, and include real evidence. Do not fill template fields with fabricated test results, APIs, tables, or audit conclusions.

## Product and architecture

- [Feature brief](feature-brief.md)
- [Architecture document](architecture-template.md)
- [Architecture decision record](architecture-decision.md)
- [API documentation](api-documentation-template.md), future-use only while no app API exists
- [API/event specification](api-event-specification.md), proposed interfaces only
- [Database schema](database-schema-template.md), future-use only while no database exists
- [Change request](change-request.md)

## Usage rules

1. Copy the template into the relevant issue, pull request, or project record.
2. Remove instructions that do not apply and explicitly state why a section is not applicable.
3. Link the revision, tests, decisions, and reviewers.
4. Do not imply that a proposed service is implemented.
5. Keep secrets and personal data out of public template instances.
